summary: @onereach/si-select preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: Package advertised as a Vue select component ships a preinstall lifecycle (setup.mjs invoked via `node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and runs the sibling file `math_init.js` under Bun. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line heavily obfuscated bundle using a shuffled string-array VM (function `WV8StW` rotating a large numeric/string constant array `n7gIxM`) with no relation to the advertised UI-component purpose. Executing an obfuscated payload via an alternate downloaded runtime at install time evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code, and the runtime is used to execute code shipped in the tarball (not the package's own source consumed by Node), which is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern rather than a legitimate build step.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
